assumptions: UNTESTED: at least one coordinate family has a stable eight-term expansion advantage rather than lying inside random-set variance.
HEURISTIC: 31 replicates per null family provide a useful toy-scale percentile screen, not an asymptotic distribution.
MODEL-BOUND: shuffled Python support-map scans model an online fixed-curve lookup and not optimized hardware bandwidth.
falsification_conditions: No coordinate family reaches the preregistered support and frontier percentiles against both null families in six of nine clean instances spanning all sizes and seeds.
A candidate statistic changes by more than 25 percent across preregistered support-order permutations.
A candidate requires an anomalous, supersingular, special-j, non-prime-order, or nonmonotone-q instance.
Independent reconstruction or exact source-hash verification fails.
interpretation_limits: A percentile pass would establish a toy additive-geometry signal, not split compression or an ECDLP algorithm.
The 12-16 bit sweep cannot establish an exponent.
Rank, sparse linear algebra, factor-base logarithms, and individual target descent remain mandatory later gates.
The p mod 4 = 3 field restriction remains explicit.
hypothesis.mechanism: A coordinate-defined sign-complete set may expand more efficiently from four-term advice to eight-term coverage than typical random-scalar or random-x sets at matched cardinality, yielding an order-robust fixed-curve coverage signal even when its four-term support is not compressed.

predictions.metric: exact eight-term support percentile against each paired null family
coverage efficiency |8A|/|4A|^2 percentile against each paired null family
order-robust functional frontier percentile against each paired null family
offline group operations ratio to median random-x

hypothesis.statement: At least one tested coordinate family has exceptional sign-complete eight-term coverage and order-robust frontier efficiency against both replicated null families on clean curves.

instances: three deterministic clean prime-order curves per bit size
